title: Use it for small, related controls

do.text: Use a popover for a few controls tied to its trigger: dimensions, a couple of settings.

dont.text: Don't open a popover just to say what a button does: use a [Tooltip](/components/tooltip), or a clearer label.

do.text: Keep a popover to what fits beside its trigger.

dont.text: Don't fit a whole form in a popover: use a [Sheet](/components/sheet) or a [Dialog](/components/dialog).
